units.source_text: 次日，源氏公子写信给北山的老尼姑。

en.t: The next day, Prince Genji wrote a letter to the old nun at Kitayama.

units.source_text: 另有一信给僧都，也约略谈及此事。

en.t: He also sent another letter to the bishop, briefly touching on the matter as well.

units.source_text: 给老尼姑的信中说道：“前日有请，未蒙惠允。

en.t: In the letter to the old nun, he wrote: "The other day I made a request, but I was not granted your kind consent.

units.source_text: 因此惶恐，不敢详诉衷情，实甚遗憾。

en.t: Because of that, I was so overawed that I did not dare explain my true feelings in detail, which I deeply regret.
Today I send this letter especially to ask after you.

units.source_text: 小生此心，实非寻常之人可比。

en.t: This heart of mine truly cannot be compared with that of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 倘蒙俯察下怀，三生有幸。”

en.t: If you would graciously understand my humble feelings, I would count myself fortunate for three lifetimes."

units.source_text: 另附一张打成结的小纸，上面写道：

en.t: He also enclosed a small piece of paper tied into a knot, on which was written:
